open_questions.description: What noise threshold to use below the peak -- fifteen dB was picked arbitrarily and twelve or twenty may be better -- and whether it should adapt rather than be fixed across the utterance
Whether combining the two feature streams would gain anything, given how different they are

notes: No decisions, actions or risks. The apparent risk -- me013's 'you're still getting more recognition errors' at seg-0021 -- is withdrawn four turns later when me018 asks 'So performance went down?' and mn007 answers 'No. It didn't.' Recording it would mean reporting a threat the case explicitly retracts. mn007 returns to the threshold at seg-0065 ('still a factor we have to look at'), which is the same open question restated, so it is one item cited at the earliest turn where it is recognisable.
